m01.title: Crop Planning and Farming Guidance
m01.desc: Crop recommendations based on soil, season, water and budget with NPK fertilizer dosing and calendar.

m02.title: AI Crop Doctor
m02.desc: Upload crop leaf photos, select observed symptoms, identify pests/diseases, and get organic neem remedies.

m03.title: Weather and Alerts
m03.desc: Hyperlocal 7-day weather forecast, rainfall probability, humidity, heat alerts and spraying safety advice.

m04.title: Market Prices and Selling
m04.desc: APMC mandi spot prices, 7-day trend, and 3-channel harvest proceeds calculator (Mandi vs FPO vs Farmgate).

m05.title: Government Schemes and Insurance
m05.desc: PM-KISAN, PMFBY crop insurance, 100% drip subsidy 3-question eligibility check and document checklist.

m06.title: Farm Finance and Profit
m06.desc: Cultivation cost calculator, Net Profit = Revenue − Costs, and 4% KCC loan repayment simulator.

m07.title: Farmer Community and Expert Support
m07.desc: Ask farming questions, share experiences, read answers, and connect with verified agricultural experts.

m08.title: Equipment and Resource Sharing
m08.desc: Tractor and machinery custom hiring rates (CHC), farm labour crew listings, and equipment rental enquiries.

m09.title: Livestock and Allied Farming
m09.desc: Cattle, goat and poultry healthcare, vaccination calendar, and direct 1-tap call to 1962 Animal Ambulance.

m10.title: Farm Management
m10.desc: Manage farmland plots, record land size & soil type, track sowing dates, task lists, and harvest ledger.
